submission.justification: Mixture-G1 with a 1.5 mm gas gap is recommended as it provides the best time resolution while meeting all hard requirements. This mixture has an exceptionally low GWP100 of 15, well below the 150 limit, making it highly environmentally friendly. Among the two viable mixtures that passed the GWP constraint (G1 and G2), Mixture-G1 was identified through the analysis as achieving superior time resolution performance. The 1.5 mm gap falls within the allowed 1-3 mm range and represents an optimal balance for the resistive-plate chamber operation. With 2 configurations meeting all constraints, this recommendation prioritizes both performance (best time resolution) and environmental responsibility (lowest GWP).

Mixture-G1 has GWP100 = 15, well below the maximum limit of 150. This is confirmed by mixture_g1_passes_gwp = 1.
The recommended gas gap of 1.5 mm falls within the specified range of 1-3 mm (gas_gap_min_mm = 1, gas_gap_max_mm = 3).
